Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired service=textgen-gpu-prod severity=high id=PD-9999 symptom=95th_latency>1.2s
Tess: acked. I'm on-call and taking this.
PagerDuty: Alert PD-9999 acknowledged by Tess
Sam V: grafana confirms big oscillation on p95/p99. digging into router & batching metrics now.
Leah M: any 5xx or customer errors showing? dashboards only show latency spikes so far.
Tess: quick context — I just finished a throughput run and changed ROUTER_BATCH=72 on the prod canary earlier. rolling that back to baseline 32 now.
Tess: running:
```
# rollback batch size
kubectl set env deployment/model-router ROUTER_BATCH=32 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-router -n prod
```
Sam V: looking through request logs, spikes line up with very long prompts, no 5xx though. examples:
```
2026-03-12T09:12:03.001Z INFO req=xyz prompt_tokens=3500 latency_ms=1420 model=gpt-open-xxl
2026-03-12T09:12:03.110Z INFO req=xyy prompt_tokens=120 latency_ms=85 model=gpt-open-xxl
```
Incident Bot: PagerDuty escalation timer set for 4m
Tess: rollout restart submitted, watching pods. hoping p95 drops once new pods spin up.
Sam V: pods coming up clean, readiness ok. p95 started trending down ~20s after restart.
PagerDuty: Alert PD-9999 resolved (auto-resolved) reason=threshold_recovered timestamp=1760002253
Leah M: looks like a noisy/auto-resolved page. no customer-facing errors observed, no follow-up incident needed.
Tess: will update the oncall playbook: do not change batch size in prod without a canary traffic test + monitor smoothed p95 for 2 windows.
Priya R: apologies — that was my throughput experiment, I missed the canary step. pushing a runbook update to include an explicit canary gate and a post-change dashboard check.
Sam V: filing ticket to add a short alert-dampening rule and to consider special routing for prompts >2k tokens (route to larger instances or slower path).
Tess: SGTM. If this recurs we'll escalate for deeper infra changes. adding a short blameless note to #postmortems.
Leah M: marking as auto-resolved. will watch the trend for 24h.
Tess: handoff — I'm on until 16:00 PT, Priya back next shift. closing thread unless PagerDuty re-pages.
Incident Bot: Thread closed (no further activity).
